note: Copy outside the repository and keep it untracked. endpoint is an EXISTING OpenCodex service started and owned by the operator; this module never starts, stops or restarts it. Configuration changes happen only as saved Operations: one operator-written request file per change, executed by `node bridge.mjs --config <this file> configure <request.json>` (client-integration changes additionally require a prior `preview` and the confirmed planFingerprint). adminTokenEnv names the environment variable holding the service's MANAGEMENT (admin) credential - a different credential from any data-plane/proxy admission key and from the Codex app-server token. The token itself never appears in this file, in bridge output, in a Task/Operation, or in diagnostics.
